segments.text: Many of our existing laptops and ICT equipment are already obsolete, defective, or beyond their useful life.

segments.speaker: GCG Chairperson Atty. Marius P. Corpus
segments.text: Continued reliance on these devices affects productivity.

segments.text: One of the most significant risks faced by any digital organization is the loss of critical systems during a disaster or major disruption.

segments.speaker: GCG Chairperson Atty. Marius P. Corpus
segments.text: At present, the GCG does not have its own disaster recovery facility and remains dependent on shared resources outside the agency.

segments.speaker: GCG Chairperson Atty. Marius P. Corpus
segments.text: Establishing a dedicated disaster recovery site will ensure the continued availability of critical systems and minimize downtime of digital services relied upon by the GOCC sector and the general public.

segments.speaker: GCG Chairperson Atty. Marius P. Corpus
segments.text: This initiative aims to enhance and sustain the GCG main office data center infrastructure to ensure the continuous, secure, and reliable delivery of ICT services.

segments.speaker: GCG Chairperson Atty. Marius P. Corpus
segments.text: Recent incidents, including power infrastructure failure and water leakage from malfunctioning air conditioning units, have highlighted the need to improve the data center's resiliency, reliability, and business continuity

segments.speaker: GCG Chairperson Atty. Marius P. Corpus
segments.text: capabilities to support the Commission's expanding digital operations.

segments.speaker: GCG Chairperson Atty. Marius P. Corpus
segments.text: Recent incidents, including the interrupted power source overheating and water leakages within the data center, have highlighted vulnerabilities that could potentially affect critical ICT infrastructure and services.

segments.text: Kasi alam mo bakit, Mr. Chair?

segments.text: Maraming beses na ako nakakatanggap ng reklamo sa programa ko.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: And then pupunta dito sa DTI,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Hanggang sa magsawa na lang yung consumer,

segments.text: Dito sa in-place na sistema nila,

segments.text: 30 days muna to file the complaint.

segments.text: Magkakaroon po ng fine or penalty po yung respondent natin.

segments.text: Pwede ba iksik siya nyo naman?

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Siguro nung ginawa yung sistema ninyo,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: yung nag-craft nung polisiyan yung yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: kasi maraming levels yan, di ba?

DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.
segments.text: If I may just give an overview.

segments.speaker: DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.
DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.
segments.text: ang nareceive po namin is about 42,000 complaints.

segments.speaker: DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.
segments.text: Kaya po meron tayong mediation para mabawasan po yun.

segments.speaker: DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.
segments.text: Ang average days po natin sa mediation is about 10 to 15 days.

segments.speaker: DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.
DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.

segments.text: how many of that 42,000 gets settled at that,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Huwag naman sana lahat ng 42,000 aabot ng taon.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I'm sure first phase pa lang, maraming nang masasettle dyan.

DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.
DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.

segments.text: a majority are settled within the mediation stage na kapag-usap po yun.

segments.text: Can you give us the numbers?

segments.text: Kasi I'm sure every year yan ang metrics ninyo, di ba?

segments.text: Kasi usually, kakausapin nyo nalang yung business, sabihin nyo,

segments.text: So, yung 20% na natira, aabot ba sila ng 6 buwan?

segments.speaker: DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.
Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Bigay mo sa amin yung metrics nyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: So, ang tanong nga, kung susugan ko yung tanong ni Chairman.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: So, ilan yung percentage doon sa 30 to 20% na nasesettle at nagiging satisfied yung consumer?

segments.speaker: DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.
segments.text: For NCR po, under our jurisdiction, ang nasesettle po sa mediation is 100% po.

segments.speaker: DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.

segments.text: Okay. Sa lahat ng klaseng produkto, regardless?

segments.speaker: DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.
DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.

segments.text: Bibigyan kita ng listahan ng mga pumunta sa akin.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Meron Nissan na isusuli dahil sira talaga.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: And then, meron pangang certification from the manufacturer na may problema at ni-recall na yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero matigas pa rin yung seller.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Because I can get back to you.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: And to show you proof na hindi 100%.

segments.speaker: DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.
segments.text: Upon clarification, Your Honor, hindi po settled.

segments.speaker: DTI Assistant Secretary Atty. Regino D. Mallari Jr.
segments.text: Some of the, especially yung mga technical cases po, especially yung mga cases po na under the Lemon Law, nagpo-proceed po sa adjudication.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ihagis ko sa iyo mga papel ng mga reklamo sa akin through the years na inaabot na po siguro ng dose-dose na na.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: And ako naman tumatawag sa inyo every time.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: So, yun po yung dapat ang sinasabi ko ngayon.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Mag-come up kayo ng sistema na para mapaiksi naman yung adjudication.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: And then, after six months, kung hindi pa na-settle,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: dapat gumawa na kayo ng mga hakbang na para paborabi doon sa consumer.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Hindi naman magreklamo yung consumer kung hindi siya sa tingin niya siya ay nadehado o siya ay he'd been had or she'd been had.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: The consumer, if they're happy with the product, why would they complain?

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: They're not gonna waste their time to complain.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: So, para sa akin, iksiyan niyo lang po yung ano siguro yung proseso.
